items.information:
## Welcome to the Malaysia Cube Championship 2023!

[![](https://i.imgur.com/oRN01S9m.jpg)](https://beacons.ai/malaysiacubechampionship)

For more information, you may visit us at [Malaysia Cube Championship 2023 Website](https://beacons.ai/malaysiacubechampionship)


**Kindly read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information.**

**Please note** 
Competitors of all nationalities are welcome,

There will be **2 types of winner** in this competition:
**Open Category**  -  Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality 
**Malaysian Category** - Top 3 Malaysian winners of the competition

*Participants representing Malaysia will have the opportunity to win special trophies, prizes, and the title of Malaysia Champion. The number of competitors in all final rounds may increase until there are at least 6 Malaysian competitors who advance*


***Our schedule is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***

items.name: Malaysian Cube Championship 2017
items.information:
Malaysian Cube Championship 2017 is opened to all nationalities, but only Malaysians are eligible to win the prizes.


**Registration info**
* Registration opens on Tuesday, 7th November, 8pm (GMT+8).
* The steps for registration are as follows:
1. [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysianCubeChampionship2017/register) 
2. [Pay](https://www.mycubeassociation.com/payment-malaysiancubechamp) according the the events you registered.
3. Once we have confirmed correct payment, we will accept your registration.

**In order to complete your registration please proceed with the payment according to the events registered. Payment which does not match with the event registered will not be accepted and the payment will be refund.
